alt: Production paused after the 2023 model year; a redesigned Bolt returned later.

issues.sym: Usually no warning beforehand; in rare cases smoke or fire from under the car, often while charging or after charging to full.
issues.why: Some battery cells had manufacturing defects that could cause an internal short. GM recalled every Bolt EV of these years and replaced battery modules or packs.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls right away. Until the remedy is done, follow GM's charging limits and park outside, away from buildings.

issues.t: Battery monitoring software not installed correctly
issues.sym: Usually nothing you notice, which is why the VIN check matters.
issues.why: Diagnostic software added during the battery recall was not installed correctly on some cars, so a faulty battery module could go undetected. GM issued follow-up recalls to reinstall it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have a Chevrolet EV dealer confirm the latest battery software is installed. Park outside until it is.

issues.t: Sudden loss of power with charge still showing
issues.sym: The range estimate drops quickly or the car loses drive power while the gauge still shows charge left, sometimes with a propulsion power reduced message.
issues.why: The battery software could miss a weak group of cells dropping to low voltage, so it overestimated range and gave little warning before shutting down propulsion. GM released a software update, and some cars got new battery packs.
issues.next: Make sure GM bulletin 18125 (N172127150) and all later battery updates are done. If range suddenly falls, keep the charge higher and have the battery checked.

issues.t: Seat belt pretensioner can ignite carpet after a crash
issues.sym: Nothing before a crash. After a crash that fires the front seat belt pretensioners, smoke or flames could come from the carpet near the door pillar.
issues.why: Hot gas from the pretensioner could ignite nearby carpet. GM recalled affected cars to add foil shielding, then recalled some again because the first repair was not done correctly.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. After any crash, get everyone out and watch for smoke near the front seats.

issues.t: Rear brake calipers may lose braking force
issues.sym: Weaker braking or a brake pedal that travels farther than normal.
issues.why: A coating on the rear caliper pistons may be insufficient, letting gas pockets form that reduce rear braking. GM recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for an open recall and have the calipers replaced. Get the brakes checked before driving if the pedal feels different.

issues.t: Front left brake caliper may crack
issues.sym: Usually no warning before it breaks; a cracked caliper can cause a soft pedal, a pull to one side, or leaking brake fluid.
issues.why: Some front left calipers were cast improperly and could fracture under high braking pressure. GM recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for an open recall. If braking feels weak or you see fluid, do not drive until it is inspected.

issues.sym: The rear inside door handle may stop working, or a rear door could open when you do not expect it.
issues.why: The rear inside door-handle cable may be too long. GM recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for an open recall and keep children away from rear doors that behave oddly until the repair is done.

issues.t: Seat belt may not be properly anchored
issues.sym: Usually nothing you notice; a belt anchor could feel loose.
issues.why: The wrong bolts may have been used to attach some seat belts. GM recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for an open recall and have the anchors inspected and corrected.

issues.t: Driver airbag may not be secured
issues.sym: Often nothing you can see; an airbag warning light may appear in some cases.
issues.why: A fastener holding the driver airbag to the steering wheel could be missing or loose from the factory. GM recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the dealer inspect and tighten the fasteners.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy correctly
issues.sym: Nothing you can see in normal driving.
issues.why: Some instrument panels were missing a tear seam needed for the passenger airbag to deploy properly. GM recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for an open recall and have the instrument panel repaired.
